name: redaction-allowlist-hardening
title: Harden response-header redaction against nonstandard credential headers
description: otel-activity.log serializes every response header on HTTP errors, but only 5 header names are masked; a credential echoed by an upstream in a nonstandard header (X-Auth-Token, X-Amz-Security-Token, X-Session-Id) lands on disk unmasked. Flip to mask-unless-known-safe and correct the overstated docstring.
creator: sdelmas
